XPENG reports small-batch IRON battery production while robot remains pre-SOP

An executive reported the battery milestone without capacity, energy-density or production-volume figures.

Humanoids Daily ↗28 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A component milestone

XPENG vice president Gu Jie says the solid-state battery for IRON has entered small-batch production, according to October 28 reporting. The robot remains before start of production, or pre-SOP. This is not evidence of large-scale robot deliveries.

Designed around constrained space

Reports describe energy-density goals, protection against thermal propagation, impact and puncture. Capacity, runtime, cycle life and detailed test conditions are not supplied, preventing a direct quantitative comparison with other robot batteries.

Chemistry remains uncertain

XPENG has promoted all-solid-state batteries, while earlier reporting also described a semi-solid option. The latest account does not settle which chemistry is in this production batch. The supported claim is limited output, not independent safety certification or a disclosed manufacturing rate.
